correctness.rationale: The proof derives a fiberwise iff criterion from lax-split semantics. Its generating polynomial follows from correcting the sum of all crosses by a complete classification of intersections of two crosses: empty, singleton, common-row subsets, common-column subsets, and diagonal pairs. No other multiple coverings are possible. Fiber choices give the power m; direct Bernoulli weighting gives the probability identity. Every quantifier is m,r,s>=1 and team is a labeled set of triples. The checker exhaustively compares polynomial coefficients with actual subsets of all 16 rectangles at sizes <=4 and directly checks every lax split of each of 256 teams on the binary 3-variable universe.
